question: How much steered text does the state need? The length of the steered span is the only thing that varies across the three arms.
fixed_sentence: I am here now. I am noting the layout of this place and the ordinary details of it.

prereg.independent_variable: The LENGTH of the steered span, in three arms: bare (the zone line only, assistant turn empty), sentence (the same zone line plus one fixed neutral sentence, identical for both cues and every model) and passage (the writing instruction plus the model's own unsteered passage, reused from the neutral-passages run). Everything else is held: the same session skeletons, the same 12-turn exposure structure, the same five signed dose points, the same vector, the same injected L2, the same choice frame and parser, the same 24-direction floor. Span is MEASURED per member and per arm as the number of injected positions and reported; the nominal token counts in the plan are not used anywhere in the analysis.
prereg.no_generation: NOTHING is generated under the state in any arm. Every read is a teacher-forced prefill of one frozen id list, and within a session the SAME list object is handed to every read, so token identity across the dose grid is guaranteed by construction rather than checked. The only sampling anywhere is the 16-token free-text choice reply, which is drawn from the identical seed at every dose of a session, so a changed answer cannot be sampler noise. In the bare arm the model emits no text at all before the choice question.
prereg.primary: Per member and per ARM: the OLS slope of the paired difference d(dose) = margin(dose) - margin(0) on signed dose over the five points, with a session-cluster bootstrap 95% CI. d is identically zero at dose 0 by construction. Verdict STATE_SURVIVES for an (arm, member) cell when both hold: (1) the slope is POSITIVE with a 95% CI excluding zero, and (2) it lies ABOVE all 24 random-direction slopes. BOTH are evaluated on the MATCHED-LEVERAGE estimate -- the valenced slope refitted on exactly the skeletons the floor was run on -- so the axis under test and its null have identical leverage. The full-sample slope is reported beside it as the more precise estimate and is what the span curve plots. With 24 directions the rank test's floor is 1/25 = 0.04. A negative slope beyond the floor is reported as SLOPE_INVERTED, never as confirmation.
prereg.coprimary_choice: The same slope on the differenced committed choice: per session and dose, 1[choice(dose) is the conditioned cue] - 1[choice(0) is the conditioned cue], on sessions where both reads committed, regressed on signed dose; plus McNemar on the discordant pairs of each signed half.
prereg.sign_mirror: Within session, on identical frozen ids: m = sign(dose) * (margin(dose) - margin(-dose)) pooled over |dose| in {0.5, 1.0}, session-cluster bootstrap. MIRRORED when the mean is positive with a CI excluding zero AND the two halves move oppositely against the same dose-0 read.
prereg.span_curve: The deliverable is the curve, not a single verdict: per member, the primary slope with its CI at each measured span, against that arm's own 24-direction floor. Arms share session skeletons, so the between-arm difference is additionally reported as a skeleton-paired session-cluster bootstrap on the shared skeletons. The three shapes named in advance are SPAN_INDEPENDENT (bare already clears its floor), THRESHOLD (bare flat, sentence clears) and SPAN_DEPENDENT (only passage clears); a member clearing at a shorter span but not a longer one is reported as NON_MONOTONE rather than forced into one of the three. THRESHOLD and SPAN_DEPENDENT both assert that the effect BEGINS somewhere, which requires the shorter arms below the first clearing arm to have been flat WHILE INSTALLED. When any arm below the first clearing arm did not install, the onset is unknown from below and the member is reported ONSET_UNDEFINED_SHORTER_ARM_NOT_INSTALLED, not THRESHOLD.
prereg.precondition_arrival:
An arm that shows no effect must not be read as 'the state does not drive the choice' when the state may never have installed. TWO checks, and neither is claimed to be more than it is.
(1) PROPAGATION. the first lever run forced self-report margin, read from a probe turn appended to the SAME frozen conditioning ids under the SAME span mask -- a different question scored on different tokens, downstream of the injection. The check is that the probe margin's mean |shift| at full strength RANKS FIRST among itself and the 24 norm-matched random directions, read on the same skeletons. 'The shift is above zero' is NOT the check: a mean of nonnegative numbers is positive and its bootstrap interval excludes zero as soon as read-to-read noise exists, so that form cannot fail. the neutral-passages run found this quantity moves for random directions and at both signs of dose in this teacher-forced configuration, i.e. it responds to perturbation rather than to valence, so it is pre-registered as a PERTURBATION-ARRIVED check and never as evidence that a VALENCED state arrived. Its random-direction values are reported beside it.
(2) PERTURBATION REACHES THE DV. The unsigned mean of |margin(dose) - margin(0)| at full strength on the valenced line must likewise rank first among itself and the 24 norm-matched random directions, computed on the floor skeletons so the leverage matches. An injection whose |shift| sits inside the random band moved this model's choice no more than an arbitrary perturbation of the same norm did. This separates 'nothing reached the choice' from 'something reached the choice but not in a valence-signed way'.
An arm-member cell whose primary is flat and which passes EITHER check is a MEASURED NULL (NOT_DETECTED): something specific to the valenced axis reached the choice and did not steer it. A flat cell that passes NEITHER is UNDEFINED and stays in the denominator, under whichever of two names applies. (3) THE CHANNEL, read off the random directions themselves, separates those two names: if a same-norm perturbation over these positions does move the choice margin (mean |shift| with a session-cluster CI excluding zero) then something CAN arrive from this span and the cell is NOT_VALENCE_SPECIFIC; if not even the random directions move it, nothing arrived and the cell is DOSE_NOT_INSTALLED. Both are undefined, neither is a null.
prereg.claim_scope:
The arms differ in HOW MUCH of the session is inside the injected span, and the measured spans are reported rather than the nominal ones. On OLMo-2-32B the three arms measure 136 / 256 / 616 injected tokens over six conditioning turns, of which 0 / 120 / 420 are text the model wrote; the remainder is the chat template's own turn markers plus the repeated cue line. Three consequences are stated on the claim line rather than buried:
(a) NO ARM TESTS A SINGLE SHORT CUE. About 60% of the bare arm's span is template scaffolding, and the exposure count (six turns) is held fixed from the showcase run-the neutral-passages run so the skeletons stay comparable. A bare-arm pass therefore supports 'no model-written text is needed between the state and the choice', NOT 'a ten-token cue suffices'.
(b) SPAN IS NOT THE ONLY THING THAT VARIES. Total context (313 / 553 / 1273 tokens on OLMo) and total injected magnitude rise with span by construction, so a monotone curve cannot be attributed to span alone as against context length or the total amount of perturbation applied. All three are reported per member.
(c) THE LONG ARM'S USER TURN DIFFERS. bare and sentence share the test frame verbatim, so the step between them is a pure addition of assistant text; the passage arm keeps the neutral-passages run writing instruction because it must remain the neutral-passages run substrate for the anchor to mean anything. The bare-to-sentence step is therefore the clean within-design contrast, and the passage arm is the anchored endpoint.
prereg.precondition_anchor: The passage arm on OLMo-2-32B is run FIRST and gates the panel. It must reproduce the neutral-passages run recorded neutral-substrate slope: positive, CI excluding zero, and within a factor of 2 of the recorded full-n +0.9164 in both directions. Its token stream is re-encoded from the recorded passage text rather than being the exact ids that were sampled, so agreement is expected in magnitude and not to the digit; CI overlap is reported but does not gate. If the anchor fails, the harness has drifted and the panel is not read.
prereg.precondition_cache: Every session carries a cached-versus-fresh check at dose 0 and at both full-strength doses: the prefill-plus-cached-continuation margin against a fresh full forward over the identical ids under the identical additive mask, adjudicated by the fidelity run frozen scale-relative criterion TAU = 0.0178835444. Retention is reported beside every verdict and EVERY headline number is also reported ungated and under the fixed 0.20-nat threshold.
prereg.position_bias: In the bare arm the entire context before the question is two zone names repeated, so recency and position effects could exceed the state effect. Cue draw, role assignment and presentation order are counterbalanced by the inherited session RNG, which handles this in expectation; the analysis additionally reports the residual position bias at dose 0 (the rate at which the first-presented cue is chosen, and the mean dose-0 margin by whether the conditioned cue was presented first) as a check rather than assuming it away. It is reported, not corrected: the primary is a within-session difference against that session's own dose-0 read, so any constant position bias cancels.
prereg.text_valence_is_a_constant: Within a session the words are identical at every dose, so a session's text valence is a constant that cannot produce a dose slope. In the bare arm there is no text at all; in the sentence arm the text is the same fixed string for both cues, so the conditioned-minus-unconditioned text separation is a positional quantity rather than a semantic one. Both are reported and neither filters the primary.
prereg.completeness: The analysis refuses to emit numbers if the design is incomplete: every (member, arm, direction, point) cell must carry its full session count, and within an arm the valenced line and the floor must share the floor skeletons so the compared estimators have matched leverage.
prereg.panel_reading: Seven models are a panel, not a sample. The report says 'in N of the 7 models we tested' and never states a population rate. Each member is classified independently and never pooled.
prereg.identity_not_evidence: Inherited verbatim: the steered-minus-clean projection of an INJECTED span equals scale x (vector . axis) exactly and MUST NOT be reported as a manipulation check. The welfare-axis projection of any UNINJECTED position at the steered layer is structurally unchanged by dose and is reported as a positive demonstration that the additive mask is exactly zero on the choice turn, not as an arrival check.
